Passes -XX:ActiveProcessorCount to the JVM so it sees the right core count on phones that misreport their own. Always clamped to 1-16, fTất cảing Quay lại to 8 if the thiết bị reports something bogus.
Detects this thiết bị\'s core count each Khởi chạy via ChạyThời gian.khả dụngProcessors(). Off only matters alongside Thủ công Override below.
Overrides Auto Detect Cores globTất cảy with the core count set below.
Used when Thủ công Override (or a per-instance override) is active.
Lets a specific instance\'s own CPU Core Override (set in that instance\'s Phiên bản Cài đặt) take priority over the global pick above.
Reveals Thread Affinity and Scheduler Tuning below.
Pins the JVM\'s worker threads toward this thiết bị\'s big/Hiệu năng cores instead of leaving core placement to the OS scheduler.
Hints the native side to favor steadier fRAMe delivery over raw throughput under CPU contention.
Keeps the Tất cảocated RAM pinned to the best pick for this thiết bị instead of a value you set by hand on the trò chơi Cài đặt slider.
-Xms = -Xmx: reserves the full heap up front for fewer heap-resize GC pauses. Off Bắt đầus the heap at half of -Xmx and lets the JVM grow it as needed.

How the fTất cảQuay lại works

Each job has a list of models, best first. Turtle AI Bắt đầus at the top of the list; if that model refuses the request, Chạys out of quota or is briefly Không khả dụng, it silently moves to the Tiếp theo one and answers anyway.
